strategy: Complete geographically connected clusters before opening isolated metros.

completedBaseline.note: All existing super-enrichment campaign verifiers pass locally. Production publication remains a maintainer decision.

activeCluster.name: Birmingham city completion
activeCluster.reason: Birmingham is the largest coherent city-level visitor-information gap remaining after the South Florida connector, with three existing parent guides ready for destination-level completion.
activeCluster.releaseStandard: Keep the restored official parent answers visible, retain three to four licensed parent photos, and publish only Birmingham subsites with exact reviewed coordinates, destination-specific licensed photography, and complete visitor answers.

completed: Fixed the parent-information merge so later image-only campaign records no longer erase richer official visitor facts.
Restored 937 sourced answers across 66 parent parks in 35 metros, including 43 answers across Railroad Park, Red Mountain Park, and Ruffner Mountain.
Strengthened the shared verifier so every campaign now checks the public generated parent answer set, not only the source record.
All 51 super-enrichment campaign verifiers pass with zero failures.
resumeCheckpoint.nextAction: Secure destination-specific reusable photos and exact reviewed coordinates for the highest-value Birmingham subsites, beginning with Railroad Park's 17th Street Plaza and play areas, Red Mountain Park's Sensory Trail and Remy's Dog Park, and Ruffner Mountain's Nature Center and quarry destinations.
